records.title: QatarEnergy seeks US LNG deals through to 2031, sources say
records.claim: QatarEnergy is negotiating multi-year US LNG supply through 2031, seeking roughly 2-3 mtpa as it manages long-duration outage risk at damaged Ras Laffan capacity.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: QatarEnergy seeks US LNG deals through to 2031, sources say

records.boundary: Negotiations are not signed contracts; final volume, price formula, destination flexibility and timing remain undisclosed.

records.title: IEA warns 2026 oil supply gap will widen on delayed return of normal Gulf flows
records.claim: IEA expects 2026 global oil supply to fall 5.7 mbpd, August inventories to have drawn at 3.1 mbpd, and demand to fall 2.5 mbpd, with supply losses still larger than demand destruction.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: IEA warns 2026 oil supply gap will widen on delayed return of normal Gulf flows

records.boundary: IEA values are agency estimates and forecasts; Saudi-reported figures differ and the outlook is not realized full-year data.

records.title: Oil tanker rates hit record highs following Iran, US shipping attacks
records.claim: Gulf of Oman to China VLCC freight reached about Worldscale 450, roughly $11.50/bbl, with risk-driven rate pressure spilling into West Africa-Asia routes.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: Oil tanker rates hit record highs following Iran, US shipping attacks

records.boundary: This is a route-specific crude-tanker benchmark and cannot be converted into LNGC/VLGC freight without direct evidence.

records.title: How China's oil majors helped Beijing prepare for an energy crisis
records.claim: China's state oil majors increased domestic investment, production and storage while prioritizing domestic fuel supply during the crisis, accepting commercial costs in exchange for energy-security resilience.

source_identity_receipt.observed_title: How China's oil majors helped Beijing prepare for an energy crisis

records.boundary: Reuters' investment estimate is aggregate and cannot isolate policy-mandated versus purely commercial spending or firm-specific policy cost.

data_gaps: No accepted same-window complete JKM/TTF/CP-FEI/VLGC/LNGC price and freight series.
No disclosed final QatarEnergy multi-year contract terms, pricing formula or destination flexibility.
No same-window complete LNGC/VLGC war-risk surcharge series.
No firm-level decomposition of Chinese state oil-company energy-security costs.
